title: Eleven Winters at One Bench
subtitle: 手工艺与技艺 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 手工艺与技艺（文学艺术与体育·手工艺与创造）
meta: 主题语境：手工艺与技艺（文学艺术与体育·手工艺与创造）　|　核心词汇：craft　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 craft 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my great-uncle ① learned a craft that took eleven winters to hold in the hand, and he said the learning was the whole of the sitting. The ② craft, meaning the skill and not the trade, filled one bench and stayed that size; craft, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how slowly it is learned.

Every ③ craft in that village had the same tool box, and the ④ craft at the end, meaning the one he kept for the repair work and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever paid for twice. Craft, my grandmother said, is nine parts tool box and one part somebody willing to sit; my great-uncle said the sitting is the part that fills eleven winters.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the craft was the whole of the crossing, meaning the boat and not the skill. The ⑥ craft, meaning the boat and not any of that, is the only thing in a crossing that everybody trusts and nobody inspects; craft, she said, is either something you learn or the only word that means both a skill and a boat. He said the boat is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ craft had become a line in a census, and the census had become an argument about the tool box. The ⑧ craft of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in January, was one bench and thirty years of sitting; craft, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to sit. She said the sitting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ craft I remember is the one at the end, which he practised in 1965 and is still described as the slowest in the county. A ⑩ craft, my grandmother said in 1967, is the only thing that improves by being practised; every craft, she said, is a boat that has agreed to look like a skill. She said the boat was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 手艺（指那门技艺本身，与那门生意相对）
C. 固定搭配：learn a craft 学一门手艺
D. n. 手艺（指那个村子里每一门）
E. n. 手艺（指末尾那一门）
F. n. 船；船只（小型船只的总称）
G. n. 手艺（指统计表上提到的那一门）
H. n. 技艺；行当（抽象总称）

items.q: learned a craft that took eleven winters to hold in the hand

answers.why: learn a craft 意为“学一门手艺”，1951 年姑祖父学了一门要花十一个冬天才能握在手里的手艺。
craft 意为“手艺、工艺”，指那门技艺本身而不是那门生意，占了一张工作台。
craft 指那个村子里每一门手艺，每一门都用着同样的工具箱。
craft 指末尾那一门（他留给修理活的那门），是唯一有人付过两次钱的。
craft 意为“船、船只”，母亲说那条船就是那次摆渡的全部，指的是小船而不是那门手艺。
craft 为另一个义项，指小型船只而不是那门手艺，是摆渡里人人都信赖、却无人检查的东西。
craft 意为“手艺”，指统计表上提到的那一门，到 1959 年这门手艺成了统计表里的一行。
craft 意为“技艺、行当”，姑祖父一月写道，整件事的技艺是一张工作台三十年的坐着。
craft 意为“手艺、工艺”，我记得的是末尾那一门，他 1965 年做的，至今仍被说成全县最慢的。
craft 为抽象总称，祖母说一门手艺是唯一会因为被反复操练而变好的东西。
